```{r}
# STEP 0 - Output Setup and Helper
out_dir  <- "../output/GLM_NB"
out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "NB_Modeling_Report.txt")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

while (sink.number() > 0) sink()

if (file.exists(out_file)) file.remove(out_file)

sink(out_file)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: cluster-robust SE table (host_id)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
robust_nb <- function(model, cluster_vec) {
  V <- vcovCL(model, cluster = cluster_vec, type = "HC0")
  coeftest(model, vcov. = V)
}

library(MASS)      # glm.nb
library(lmtest)    # coeftest
library(sandwich)  # vcovCL

```

```{r}
# STEP 1 - Clean Data Loading 

# 1.1 Load data
df_clean <- read.csv("../data/processed/listings_cleaned.csv",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 1.2 Convert relevant variables to factor
df_clean$room_type <- as.factor(df_clean$room_type)
df_clean$property_type <- as.factor(df_clean$property_type)
df_clean$property_type <- relevel(df_clean$property_type, ref = "Apartment")
df_clean$neighbourhood_cleansed <- as.factor(df_clean$neighbourhood_cleansed)
df_clean$instant_bookable <- as.factor(df_clean$instant_bookable)
df_clean$cancellation_policy <- as.factor(df_clean$cancellation_policy)
df_clean$host_is_superhost <- as.factor(df_clean$host_is_superhost)
df_clean$host_identity_verified <- as.factor(df_clean$host_identity_verified)
 
```

```{r}
# STEP 2 - NB Kitchen Sink (full)
cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("GLM NEGATIVE BINOMIAL MODELING REPORT\n")
cat("Generated:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
cat("=========================================\n\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Define variable blocks for Ladder
#   - Structural: listing + location + friction (+ pricing extras)
#   - Host block: professionalism / scale
#   - Rating block: perceived quality
# Kitchen = Structural + Host + Rating
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Structural block (Table 1)
f_structural <- number_of_reviews ~
  log_price + extra_people + guests_included +
  room_type + accommodates +
  property_type +
  neighbourhood_cleansed + distance_to_center_km +
  amenities_count +
  minimum_nights + instant_bookable + cancellation_policy +
  offset(log(months_active))

# Host block additions (Table 2)
f_host_add <- ~ . +
  host_is_superhost + host_response_rate + host_acceptance_rate +
  host_identity_verified + host_response_time_ord + log_host_listings_count

# Rating block additions (Table 3)
f_rating_add <- ~ . + review_scores_rating

# Kitchen = Table 3 (full)
f_kitchen <- update(f_structural, f_host_add)
f_kitchen <- update(f_kitchen, f_rating_add)

model_nb_kitchen <- glm.nb(f_kitchen, data = df_clean)

cat("--- NB summary (kitchen) ---\n\n")
print(summary(model_nb_kitchen))

cat("\n--- Cluster-robust SE (host_id) : Kitchen ---\n\n")
print(robust_nb(model_nb_kitchen, df_clean$host_id))

cat("\n--- AIC (NB kitchen) ---\n")
cat("AIC:", AIC(model_nb_kitchen), "\n")

cat("\n--- Theta (overdispersion parameter) ---\n")
cat("theta:", model_nb_kitchen$theta, "\n")
cat("SE(theta):", model_nb_kitchen$SE.theta, "\n")

```

```{r}
# STEP 3 - Preparation Same-sample Dataset for Ladder
cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 3 - Same-sample dataset for Ladder\n")
cat("=========================================\n\n")

vars_all <- c(
  "number_of_reviews", "months_active",
  "log_price", "extra_people", "guests_included",
  "room_type", "accommodates",
  "property_type", "neighbourhood_cleansed", "distance_to_center_km",
  "amenities_count", "minimum_nights", "instant_bookable", "cancellation_policy",
  "host_is_superhost", "host_response_rate", "host_acceptance_rate",
  "host_identity_verified", "host_response_time_ord", "log_host_listings_count",
  "review_scores_rating",
  "host_id"
)

df_nb_cc <- df_clean[complete.cases(df_clean[, vars_all]), ]

cat("N (complete-case for all ladder models):", nrow(df_nb_cc), "\n")
```

```{r}
# STEP 4 - Ladder Models (NB) on SAME SAMPLE
cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 4 - NB Ladder Models (same sample)\n")
cat("=========================================\n\n")

# Table 1 — Structural
cat("-----------------------------------------\n")
cat("TABLE 1 — Structural (listing + location + friction)\n")
cat("-----------------------------------------\n\n")

model_nb_t1 <- glm.nb(f_structural, data = df_nb_cc)
print(summary(model_nb_t1))

cat("\n--- Cluster-robust SE (host_id) : Table 1 ---\n\n")
print(robust_nb(model_nb_t1, df_nb_cc$host_id))

# Table 2 — + Host
cat("\n-----------------------------------------\n")
cat("TABLE 2 — Structural + Host professionalism\n")
cat("-----------------------------------------\n\n")

model_nb_t2 <- glm.nb(update(f_structural, f_host_add), data = df_nb_cc)
print(summary(model_nb_t2))

cat("\n--- Cluster-robust SE (host_id) : Table 2 ---\n\n")
print(robust_nb(model_nb_t2, df_nb_cc$host_id))

# Table 3 — + Rating (Kitchen)
cat("\n-----------------------------------------\n")
cat("TABLE 3 — Structural + Host + Rating (Kitchen)\n")
cat("-----------------------------------------\n\n")

model_nb_t3 <- glm.nb(update(update(f_structural, f_host_add), f_rating_add), data = df_nb_cc)
print(summary(model_nb_t3))

cat("\n--- Cluster-robust SE (host_id) : Table 3 ---\n\n")
print(robust_nb(model_nb_t3, df_nb_cc$host_id))
```

```{r}
# STEP 5 - Stability checks (key drivers across ladder)
cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 5 - Stability Check (Key Drivers)\n")
cat("=========================================\n\n")

# Core drivers
key_vars <- c(
  "log_price",
  "distance_to_center_km",
  "minimum_nights",
  "instant_bookable1",
  "accommodates",
  "amenities_count",
  "host_is_superhost1",
  "host_acceptance_rate",
  "log_host_listings_count",
  "review_scores_rating"
)

extract_coefs <- function(m, vars) {
  b <- coef(m)
  out <- b[intersect(names(b), vars)]
  out
}

cat("--- Coefficients (Table 1) ---\n")
print(extract_coefs(model_nb_t1, key_vars))

cat("\n--- Coefficients (Table 2) ---\n")
print(extract_coefs(model_nb_t2, key_vars))

cat("\n--- Coefficients (Table 3) ---\n")
print(extract_coefs(model_nb_t3, key_vars))

cat("\n--- AIC Comparison (same sample) ---\n")
print(AIC(model_nb_t1, model_nb_t2, model_nb_t3))

# Quick % interpretation for a couple of common changes
cat("\n--- Quick % effects (Table 3) ---\n")

cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 6 - Likelihood Ratio Tests (NB Ladder)\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

cat("\n--- Table 1 vs Table 2 ---\n")
lrt_12 <- anova(model_nb_t1, model_nb_t2, test = "LRT")
print(lrt_12)

cat("\n--- Table 2 vs Table 3 ---\n")
lrt_23 <- anova(model_nb_t2, model_nb_t3, test = "LRT")
print(lrt_23)

b_price <- coef(model_nb_t3)["log_price"]
if (!is.na(b_price)) {
  eff_price_10pct <- exp(b_price * log(1.10)) - 1
  cat("10% higher price ->", round(100 * eff_price_10pct, 2),
      "% change in expected review rate\n")
}

b_dist <- coef(model_nb_t3)["distance_to_center_km"]
if (!is.na(b_dist)) {
  eff_dist_1km <- exp(b_dist) - 1
  cat("1 km farther from center ->", round(100 * eff_dist_1km, 2),
      "% change in expected review rate\n")
}

b_acc <- coef(model_nb_t3)["accommodates"]
if (!is.na(b_acc)) {
  eff_acc_1 <- exp(b_acc) - 1
  cat("1 more accommodates ->", round(100 * eff_acc_1, 2),
      "% change in expected review rate\n")
}

b_amen <- coef(model_nb_t3)["amenities_count"]
if (!is.na(b_amen)) {
  eff_amen_1 <- exp(b_amen) - 1
  cat("1 more amenity ->", round(100 * eff_amen_1, 2),
      "% change in expected review rate\n")
}

b_super <- coef(model_nb_t3)["host_is_superhost1"]
if (!is.na(b_super)) {
  eff_super <- exp(b_super) - 1
  cat("Superhost (vs non) ->", round(100 * eff_super, 2),
      "% change in expected review rate\n")
}

b_accpt <- coef(model_nb_t3)["host_acceptance_rate"]
if (!is.na(b_accpt)) {
  eff_accpt_10pp <- exp(b_accpt * 10) - 1  # +10 percentage points
  cat("Host acceptance rate +10pp ->", round(100 * eff_accpt_10pp, 2),
      "% change in expected review rate\n")
}

b_hscale <- coef(model_nb_t3)["log_host_listings_count"]
if (!is.na(b_hscale)) {
  cat("Host scale (log_host_listings_count): coef =", round(b_hscale, 3),
      "(interpret via scenario changes in host listings)\n")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# END
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("END OF NB MODELING\n")
cat("Report saved to:\n", out_file, "\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

sink()
```

```{r}
# STEP 7 - Kitchen IRR line plots (single model, orange line)
cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 7 - Kitchen IRR Line Plots (Orange)\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

dir_plots <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")
if (!dir.exists(dir_plots)) dir.create(dir_plots, recursive = TRUE)

KITCHEN_ORANGE <- "#F8766D"

# Extract kitchen coefficients
b_kitchen <- coef(model_nb_kitchen)

get_coef <- function(b, term) {
  if (term %in% names(b)) as.numeric(b[term]) else NA_real_
}

# Build + plot a single-line IRR chart
plot_kitchen_line <- function(terms, labels, title, subtitle, filename) {

  df_irr <- tibble(
    term = terms,
    beta = sapply(terms, function(t) get_coef(b_kitchen, t)),
    model = "Kitchen"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      irr = exp(beta),
      label = dplyr::case_when(
        term %in% names(labels) ~ labels[term],
        TRUE ~ term
      ),
      label = factor(label, levels = unname(labels[terms]))
    )

  p <- ggplot(df_irr, aes(x = label, y = irr, group = model, color = model)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(size = 3, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Kitchen" = KITCHEN_ORANGE)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Incidence Rate Ratio (IRR = exp(β))"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

  plot_file <- file.path(dir_plots, filename)
  ggsave(plot_file, p, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  cat("Saved:", plot_file, "\n")
  invisible(df_irr)
}

# -----------------------
# 1) Pricing + Location
# -----------------------
terms_1 <- c("log_price", "distance_to_center_km")
labels_1 <- c(
  log_price = "log_price",
  distance_to_center_km = "distance_to_center_km"
)
plot_kitchen_line(
  terms = terms_1,
  labels = labels_1,
  title = "Kitchen IRR — Pricing + Location (NB)",
  subtitle = "Single-model IRR pattern (Kitchen sink)",
  filename = "NB_Kitchen_IRR_Pricing_Location.png"
)

# -----------------------
# 2) Listing attributes (+ Room type)
# -----------------------
terms_2 <- c(
  "accommodates",
  "amenities_count",
  "room_typePrivate room",
  "room_typeShared room"
)
labels_2 <- c(
  accommodates = "accommodates",
  amenities_count = "amenities_count",
  `room_typePrivate room` = "private_room",
  `room_typeShared room`  = "shared_room"
)
plot_kitchen_line(
  terms = terms_2,
  labels = labels_2,
  title = "Kitchen IRR — Listing attributes + Room type (NB)",
  subtitle = "Baseline category for room_type is Entire home/apt",
  filename = "NB_Kitchen_IRR_Listing_RoomType.png"
)

# -----------------------
# 3) Transaction friction & flexibility
# -----------------------
terms_3 <- c(
  "minimum_nights",
  "instant_bookable1",
  "extra_people",
  "guests_included"
)
labels_3 <- c(
  minimum_nights = "minimum_nights",
  instant_bookable1 = "instant_bookable",
  extra_people = "extra_people",
  guests_included = "guests_included"
)
plot_kitchen_line(
  terms = terms_3,
  labels = labels_3,
  title = "Kitchen IRR — Transaction friction (NB)",
  subtitle = "Booking constraints vs pricing add-ons",
  filename = "NB_Kitchen_IRR_Transaction.png"
)

# -----------------------
# 4) Host professionalism + Ratings (robust to factor dummy naming)
# -----------------------

coef_names <- names(b_kitchen)

# helper: get the dummy term for a factor variable (everything that starts with varname)
get_factor_dummy <- function(varname, pool) {
  hits <- pool[grepl(paste0("^", varname), pool)]
  # remove the bare varname if it exists (rare)
  hits <- hits[hits != varname]
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hits[1]  # take first (binary factor should only have one)
}

t_superhost <- get_factor_dummy("host_is_superhost", coef_names)
t_verified  <- get_factor_dummy("host_identity_verified", coef_names)

terms_host_rating <- c(
  t_superhost,
  "host_response_rate",
  "host_acceptance_rate",
  t_verified,
  "host_response_time_ord",
  "log_host_listings_count",
  "review_scores_rating"
)

# keep only terms that exist in the model
terms_host_rating <- terms_host_rating[terms_host_rating %in% coef_names]

labels_host_rating <- setNames(rep(NA_character_, length(terms_host_rating)), terms_host_rating)
labels_host_rating[t_superhost] <- "superhost"
labels_host_rating["host_response_rate"] <- "response_rate"
labels_host_rating["host_acceptance_rate"] <- "acceptance_rate"
labels_host_rating[t_verified] <- "identity_verified"
labels_host_rating["host_response_time_ord"] <- "response_time_ord"
labels_host_rating["log_host_listings_count"] <- "log_host_listings_count"
labels_host_rating["review_scores_rating"] <- "rating"

plot_kitchen_line(
  terms   = terms_host_rating,
  labels  = labels_host_rating,
  title   = "Kitchen IRR — Host professionalism + Ratings (NB)",
  subtitle= "Host capability + perceived quality (factor dummies auto-matched)",
  filename= "NB_Kitchen_IRR_Host_Rating.png"
)

# -----------------------
# Neighbourhood cleansed: mixed effects (Top/Bottom extremes like property type)
# -----------------------
nbh <- tibble(
  term = coef_names,
  beta = as.numeric(b_kitchen)
) %>%
  filter(grepl("^neighbourhood_cleansed", term)) %>%
  mutate(irr = exp(beta)) %>%
  arrange(desc(irr))

if (nrow(nbh) > 0) {
  top_n <- 8  # adjust for slide readability
  nbh_pick <- bind_rows(
    nbh %>% slice_head(n = top_n),
    nbh %>% slice_tail(n = top_n)
  ) %>%
    arrange(irr)

  terms_nbh <- nbh_pick$term
  labels_nbh <- setNames(gsub("^neighbourhood_cleansed", "", terms_nbh), terms_nbh)
  labels_nbh <- trimws(labels_nbh)

  plot_kitchen_line(
    terms   = terms_nbh,
    labels  = labels_nbh,
    title   = "Kitchen IRR — Neighbourhood effects (extremes vs baseline)",
    subtitle= "Some areas much higher/lower demand: strong spatial heterogeneity",
    filename= "NB_Kitchen_IRR_Neighbourhood_TopBottom.png"
  )

  cat("\nNeighbourhood FE interpretation:\n")
  cat("Mixed effects: top areas show ~50–150% higher expected review rates,\n")
  cat("while low areas often show ~20–40% lower rates vs baseline.\n")
  cat("This supports strong spatial demand heterogeneity.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No neighbourhood_cleansed dummies found in coefficients.\n")
}

# -----------------------
# Property type as a line (Top 5 vs Bottom 5 only)
# -----------------------
pt <- tibble(
  term = names(b_kitchen),
  beta = as.numeric(b_kitchen)
) %>%
  filter(grepl("^property_type", term)) %>%
  mutate(irr = exp(beta)) %>%
  arrange(desc(irr))

if (nrow(pt) > 0) {
  top_n <- 5
  pt_pick <- bind_rows(
    pt %>% slice_head(n = top_n),
    pt %>% slice_tail(n = top_n)
  ) %>%
    arrange(irr)

  terms_pt <- pt_pick$term
  labels_pt <- setNames(gsub("^property_type", "", terms_pt), terms_pt)
  labels_pt <- trimws(labels_pt)

  plot_kitchen_line(
    terms = terms_pt,
    labels = labels_pt,
    title = "Kitchen IRR — Property type (Top/Bottom effects vs Apartment)",
    subtitle = "Only extremes shown to keep plot readable",
    filename = "NB_Kitchen_IRR_PropertyType_TopBottom.png"
  )
} else {
  cat("No property_type dummies found in model coefficients.\n")
}

```

```{r}
# STEP 8 - NB Ladder IRR Stability (Same Sample)
# =========================================

cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 8 - NB Ladder IRR Stability (Same Sample)\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

dir_plots <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")
if (!dir.exists(dir_plots)) dir.create(dir_plots, recursive = TRUE)

# Core drivers for comparison (adjust if needed)
core_vars <- c(
  "log_price",
  "accommodates",
  "distance_to_center_km",
  "instant_bookable1",
  "host_is_superhost1"
)

# Extract coefficients
b_t1 <- coef(model_nb_t1)
b_t2 <- coef(model_nb_t2)
b_t3 <- coef(model_nb_t3)

get_coef <- function(b, term) {
  if (term %in% names(b)) as.numeric(b[term]) else NA_real_
}

# Build ladder IRR table
df_ladder <- bind_rows(
  tibble(term = core_vars,
         beta = sapply(core_vars, function(t) get_coef(b_t1, t)),
         model = "Table 1"),
  tibble(term = core_vars,
         beta = sapply(core_vars, function(t) get_coef(b_t2, t)),
         model = "Table 2"),
  tibble(term = core_vars,
         beta = sapply(core_vars, function(t) get_coef(b_t3, t)),
         model = "Table 3 (Kitchen)")
) %>%
  mutate(
    irr = exp(beta),
    label = case_when(
      term == "log_price" ~ "log_price",
      term == "accommodates" ~ "accommodates",
      term == "distance_to_center_km" ~ "distance_to_center_km",
      term == "instant_bookable1" ~ "instant_bookable",
      term == "host_is_superhost1" ~ "superhost",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),
    label = factor(label,
                   levels = c("log_price",
                              "accommodates",
                              "distance_to_center_km",
                              "instant_bookable",
                              "superhost"))
  )

# Colors:
ladder_colors <- c(
  "Table 1" = "#2C7BB6",          # Blue
  "Table 2" = "#1A9850",          # Green
  "Table 3 (Kitchen)" = "#F8766D" # Orange
)

p_ladder <- ggplot(df_ladder,
                   aes(x = label, y = irr,
                       group = model, color = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ladder_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "NB Ladder Stability (Same Sample)",
    subtitle = "Structural → +Host → +Rating (Kitchen)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Incidence Rate Ratio (IRR = exp(β))"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

plot_file <- file.path(dir_plots, "NB_Ladder_IRR_Stability.png")
ggsave(plot_file, p_ladder, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

cat("Saved ladder IRR stability plot to:\n", plot_file, "\n")

# Optional sanity table
cat("\n--- Ladder IRR Table ---\n")
print(df_ladder %>% select(model, term, beta, irr))
```

```{r}
# STEP 9 - SE Comparison: Standard vs Clustered (Kitchen NB)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

# --- Key drivers only ---
key_vars <- c(
  "log_price",
  "distance_to_center_km",
  "accommodates",
  "instant_bookable1",
  "host_is_superhost1",
  "host_acceptance_rate",
  "minimum_nights"
)

# Extract standard SE
se_std <- summary(model_nb_t3)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]

# Extract clustered SE
se_cluster <- robust_nb(model_nb_t3, df_nb_cc$host_id)[, "Std. Error"]

# Helper to safely extract SE
get_se <- function(se_vec, term) {
  if (term %in% names(se_vec)) as.numeric(se_vec[term]) else NA_real_
}

# Build dataset
df_se <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    term = key_vars,
    se = sapply(key_vars, function(t) get_se(se_std, t)),
    type = "Standard SE"
  ),
  tibble(
    term = key_vars,
    se = sapply(key_vars, function(t) get_se(se_cluster, t)),
    type = "Clustered SE"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    term = factor(term, levels = key_vars)
  )

# Plot
p_se_compare <- ggplot(df_se, aes(x = term, y = se, group = type, color = type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Standard SE" = "#1ABC9C",   # Tosca
    "Clustered SE" = "#F8766D"   # Orange
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Standard vs Clustered Standard Errors (Kitchen NB)",
    subtitle = "Host-level clustering",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Standard Error"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

# Save
plot_file <- file.path(dir_plots, "NB_SE_Comparison_Kitchen.png")
ggsave(plot_file, p_se_compare, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

cat("Saved SE comparison plot to:\n", plot_file, "\n")
```
